2014_spells.draconic-senses.description: You touch a willing creature and grant it draconic senses. Until the spell ends, the target has blindsight with a range of 10 feet, and it has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or hearing.
2014_spells.draconic-senses.effectSummar: Reveal magical or hidden information within range
2014_spells.draconic-senses.fullDescript: Using 1 action, you touch a willing creature and grant it draconic senses. Until the spell ends, the target has blindsight with a range of 10 feet, and it has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or hearing. Until the spell ends, the target has blindsight with a range of 10 feet, and it has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or hearing; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
